name: fxsocket
description: Read-only MT4, MT5 and cTrader accounts on FxSocket: balances, open positions, trade history with win rate and P/L, quotes, symbol specifications and candles.

settings.name: FxSocket API key
settings.description: A read-only key (fxs_ro_...) is enough. Create one at https://app.fxsocket.com/dashboard/api-key. Kept in the system keychain and sent only to mcp.fxsocket.com.
